headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Surpasses $3.79 Billion in Day-One Global Sales
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in global sales on its first day of release, having surpassed $1.65 billion prior to launch and generating over 200 million livestream viewership hours worldwide.
why: Major video game launches represent multi-billion-dollar entertainment releases that significantly impact interactive entertainment publishing revenues and digital sales platforms.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc
impacts.why: The title generated a record $3.79 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours of commercial release.
